name: Session/nonce protection and native add-handler injection guard on every new route
Absolute quantity, native totals/fragments, purchase limits and no fractional truncation
Quantity/remove deduplication, conflict detection and stale replay cannot overwrite newer state
Fresh bag counts are isolated between guest sessions and cross-session keys cannot mutate others
Concurrent bag commands have at most one writer and maintain saved session consistency
Stock changed after selection is rejected without changing buyer quantity
